articles.headline: Ja'Quan McMillian hoping long-term future is in Denver after latest clutch play
articles.description: After Ja'Quan McMillian made a one-handed, 35-yard pick-six Sunday, his teammates surrounded him with a pay-the-man, count-that-money celebration.

images.name: McMillian  [600x600]
images.caption: Broncos cornerback and pending free agent Ja’Quan McMillian received the pay-the-man, count-that-money celebration from teammates after his pick-six Sunday vs. the Raiders.

articles.headline: RB Cam Skattebo backflips again after pledging to nix celebration
articles.description: Cam Skattebo's pledge to nix his trademark backflip didn't last long. Not even a week.

images.name: Cam Skattebo [600x400]
images.caption: Giants RB Cam Skattebo does a backflip with two minutes remaining in Sunday's win over Jacksonville.

articles.headline: Broncos coach Sean Payton awards game ball to Tom Jackson's family
articles.description: The Broncos will send a game ball to the wife and daughters of Tom Jackson after the "Orange Crush" great died Friday at age 75.

images.name: Tom Jackson photodesk [600x400]
images.alt: Portrait of Tom Jackson taken in Studio B at ESPN Headquarters

articles.headline: Inside Commanders DC Daronte Jones' unusual coaching journey
articles.description: From living in his car to various college offices, Washington defensive coordinator Daronte Jones has paid his dues.

images.name: Daronte Jones photo 2 [1296x1296]
images.caption: Jones' nearly 3-foot-long Albino Burmese Python, Goldie Gambino, accompanied him throughout his early coaching journey.

images.name: Daronte Jones photo 4 [1296x729]
images.caption: Jones slept in his 1988 Honda Prelude for two months while coaching at Chicago's North Park University.

images.name: Daronte Jones photo 5 [1296x864]
images.caption: Jones spent one season at UCLA as a grad assistant.

images.name: Daronte Jones is no stranger to adversity
images.caption: John Keim breaks down Daronte Jones' remarkable journey to the NFL.

articles.headline: NFL says no-TD call for WR Parker Washington in Jaguars' loss was correct
articles.description: The NFL said Sunday that on-field officials were correct in ruling that Parker Washington did not make a critical touchdown catch in the fourth quarter.

images.name: Parker Washington  [600x600]
images.caption: While Parker Washington believes this play should have been ruled a catch, the Giants player in coverage, Dru Phillips (22), was adamant it wasn't.

articles.headline: 49ers' Colton McKivitz exits game vs. Vikings with lower leg injury
articles.description: 49ers right tackle Colton McKivitz departed Sunday night's game against the Vikings midway through the second quarter because of what appeared to be a serious injury to his lower left leg.
